subject: Evidence request: multi-tenant KMS sampling & rotation playbook
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finsentry.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <procure@trellisprocure.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: KMS sampling, HSM operator logs, rotation playbook

Jordan,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. As part of our SIG / vendor assurance review for FinSentry, we need a short evidence package focused on key management and operator controls for multi-tenant customers. High level ask below — target delivery by EOD 12/02 if possible.

Requested items (short):
- A CSV manifest listing sampled tenant key IDs and the timeframe (just metadata; no key material).
- Representative HSM operator shift log excerpts (anonymized) covering at least two operators and two shifts.
- The current rotation playbook (PDF), with the section that explains automated vs. manual rotation highlighted.
- Mapping of SIG/CAIQ controls to the artifacts you are providing (simple CSV).
- Confirmation of at-rest wrapping (KEK) approach and whether any tenant-managed KEKs exist.

We're working to complete the SIG questionnaire next week; this evidence will be attached to the KMS section. If you prefer a secure SFTP upload rather than email attachments, we can provide SFTP credentials (we prefer encrypted transfer).

Attachments: [Attachment: finsentry_kms_questionnaire_v2.pdf (pdf)]

Appreciate a quick note on feasibility and an expected delivery time.

Best,
Liam
Senior Security Analyst, FinSentry
liam.oconnor@finsentry.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finsentry.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <procure@trellisprocure.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2029 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: KMS sampling, HSM operator logs, rotation playbook

Liam — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the set you outlined. Quick notes:

- We will not share any unwrapped key material; the manifest will contain tenant IDs (pseudonymized) and wrapped-key references.
- HSM operator excerpts will be redacted for personal identifiers but will include timestamps, operator role, and action type (import, wrap, rotate).
- Rotation playbook: we'll provide the PDF and a short changelog excerpt showing the last two changes.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: CSV that maps the questionnaire item to the artifact filename / page reference.
- For KEKs: we support both Redwood-managed KEKs (default, envelope-wrapped) and BYOK for customers who opt in. We'll explicitly state which tenants in the manifest use BYOK.

We can deliver a secure SFTP bundle by 12/02 EOD PST. If that timeline is tight for you, we can provide an interim package (manifest + short note) by EOD 11/30.

I'll loop Marissa and Ben to assemble the artifacts and handle redaction.

-Jordan
Director, Security & Compliance (inbox)
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2029 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: KMS sampling, HSM operator logs, rotation playbook

Marissa, Ben — forwarding FinSentry's ask (below). Can you work together on the artifacts? Proposed split:

Marissa: manifest CSV + SIG mapping CSV + rotation_playbook_v2.pdf (include changelog).
Ben: HSM operator excerpts + redaction and the 'KEK/Wrap' statement.

Redaction rules: remove personal names, retain operator role identifiers (OP-01) and timestamps. For the manifest, pseudonymize tenant names (TNT-#####) but include whether they are BYOK or Redwood-managed.

Target: internal draft by 11/30 EOD, final upload to secure SFTP by 12/02 18:00 PST. If you see blockers (legal, or need a DPA/NDA), flag now — Priya is CC'd on procurement.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finsentry.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Malhotra <procure@trellisprocure.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2029 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: KMS sampling, HSM operator logs, rotation playbook — package and SFTP details

Hi Liam — sending the agreed evidence bundle plan and expected artifacts. We will upload the package to the secure SFTP path below once you confirm.

Planned deliverables (uploaded as a single tar.gz):
1) redwood_kms_sampling_manifest_20291129.csv — columns: pseudonym_tenant_id, sample_window_start, sample_window_end, wrapped_key_ref, kek_type (Redwood-managed/BYOK)
2) hsm_shiftlog_sample_20291128.txt — anonymized shift excerpts (timestamps, role IDs, action types).
3) rotation_playbook_v2.pdf — production rotation playbook, section 3.2 notes automated rotation for ephemeral material and manual steps for legacy KEK rewraps.
4) sig_mapping_overview.csv — maps SIG control IDs to artifact filenames and page references.
5) supplemental_readme.txt — short notes on redaction, method, and contact for any follow-ups.

Attachments (preview stubs): [Attachment: redwood_kms_sampling_manifest_20291129.csv (csv)], [Attachment: hsm_shiftlog_sample_20291128.txt (txt)], [Attachment: rotation_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: sig_mapping_overview.csv (csv)]

SFTP upload path (temporary access to be issued): sftp://sec-share.redwood.com/finse/DEAL-8934/ (we will provide one-time credentials and rotate after upload).

A few clarifications / notes:
- Personal data: operator names are redacted; operator role IDs preserved (e.g., OP-03).
- BYOK tenants are flagged in the manifest; we do not include any key material or wrap secrets.
- The rotation playbook includes an appendix with rollback steps; we can provide a sanitized excerpt if you need deeper detail.

If that looks good, we'll upload by 12/02 15:00 PST. Please confirm SFTP is acceptable.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Manager, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finsentry.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Malhotra <procure@trellisprocure.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2029 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: KMS sampling, HSM operator logs, rotation playbook — package and SFTP details

Marissa — this plan works. SFTP upload is preferred. One follow-up: can you also include a Separation of Duties (SoD) matrix (even a one-page CSV) that shows which roles can request, approve, and perform rotation/unwrapping operations? That will help our SIG mapping.

If you can add that to the bundle prior to upload, we can close the KMS section of our review quickly.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam
Senior Security Analyst, FinSentry
